documents.extracted_text: Sahyadri Stamping & Forgings sources ~45% of cold-rolled coil from Bharat Blast Steel Ltd under quarterly supply agreements.
Kaveri Chassis & Drivetrain sources ~35% of specialty alloy steel from Bharat Blast Steel Ltd; no FY2025 supply annexure filed yet.
Secondary flat-steel allocation (~25%) is purchased on spot/short-term terms from Deccan Alloy & Flat Mills.
Malwa Precision Fasteners depends on Deccan Alloy & Flat Mills for ~40% of wire-rod and alloy bar feedstock.
Vanguard Infra EPC Ltd procures ~38% of structural steel requirements from Bharat Blast Steel Ltd for highway and bridge packages.
Narmada Bridges & Transit maintains a ~30% rebar and girder supply dependency on Deccan Alloy & Flat Mills.
Vayu Motors Passenger & Utility relies on Sahyadri Stamping & Forgings for ~42% of stamped body panels.
Konkan Commercial Vehicles sources ~50% of heavy drivetrain assemblies from Kaveri Chassis & Drivetrain.
High-tensile fasteners (~22% share) are sourced from Malwa Precision Fasteners; older FY2024 deck referenced.
Deccan Urban Metro Structures subcontracts ~28% of structural steel erection work to Vanguard Infra EPC Ltd.
